The table below is the vascular dementia codelist. I searched CPRD by term and by code prefix (Eu01, E004). I also searched for multi-infarct, arteriosclerotic, Binswanger's, mixed and post-stroke dementia. The post-stroke search found nothing.

|---|---|---|
